note: Phase 375, the probe review. readings: the integrator’s own probe:p375 run of 2026-11-25 beside the parent (10 of 10 PASS), as its report recorded them, with the two planted addresses’ hex invented again (c0ffee0a, c0ffee0b) and every path the report wrote as <run>. Filled in by the review because the run predates the fields: CARD.<build>.kept is that run’s ON.<build>.kept and CARD.<build>.want its ON.<build>.wantFace (read moments before the card); TWO.pid and every sample’s pid are one invented pid (the run did not record it); SEARCH.manifest.control is true (the run did not record it). broken: the review’s own readings broken from those, each read as its need (UNREADABLE) or clause (FAIL) says. Every address is invented under example.invalid.
